say.title: Say a message aloud
say.description: Speak one or two sentences to the people present, right now, with the numbers you were given. Use it for what must be heard (a state change, a refusal, an action); written reports go to the crew tool.

properties.text: What to say aloud, 1500 characters at most
properties.voice: Who speaks: a speaker name from the profile (agent, twin, factory, station) or an engine voice identifier
properties.priority: high interrupts and goes first, low waits, normal by default

stop.title: Stop speaking
stop.description: Stop the audio: one utterance, or everything queued.

properties.utteranceId: One utterance to withdraw; everything queued when absent
